diagrams.title: The Risk Management Process
diagrams.subtitle: Click a step, then try to reconstruct the order.

nodes.label: Identify
nodes.detail: Inventory of assets and owners: you can only protect what you know exists.
nodes.exam: Without asset identification, no analysis is reliable.

nodes.label: Assess
nodes.detail: Classify risks by category and assign a score.
nodes.exam: Assessment ≠ analysis: assessment classifies, analysis goes deeper.

nodes.label: Analyze
nodes.exam: Impact × likelihood gives criticality; ALE gives annual financial loss.

nodes.label: Treat
nodes.detail: Four options: avoid, transfer, mitigate, accept. Acceptance is a dated last resort.
nodes.exam: Accepting does not eliminate the risk: it is a "fix" on paper.

nodes.label: Monitor
nodes.detail: Risk register, communication, periodic reviews, and residual risk.
nodes.exam: Residual risk always remains after treatment.
